glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 衤 (= 衣) (“clothes”) + phonetic 里, unorthodox form of 裏.
s_page_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 田 (“field”) + 土 (“soil; earth”) – a measure of land and fields; mile; place.
note: Composite id: 里 also writes other words; this sign is the 裡 sense. glyph_origin is from the 裡 page; s_page_origin is the 里 page's own text.
